info.title: Africa Compliance Data API
info.summary: Public holidays, business days, holiday watch, VAT and VAT history, withholding tax and tax treaties, tax ID formats, filing deadlines and finance-law digests for the 54 African countries, from official sources.
info.description:
Every response cites its official sources (law, gazette or tax authority page) and states the coverage of the country for that feature. Plans: Free and Starter include the country list, holidays, business days, the holiday watch, calendar feeds and the account endpoint; Pro adds VAT (with the rate on a date and the rate history), withholding tax (with treaty rates), tax treaties, tax ID checks and filing deadlines; Compliance adds finance-law digests and change webhooks. An endpoint outside the key's plan returns 403 with an upgrade message. Rate limits per key and minute: Free 30, Starter 60, Pro 300, Compliance 1,000; full country profiles and the holiday watch also share a limit of 5 per minute. Reference data, not legal or tax advice.

Status without a key: GET https://api.africacompliancedata.com/health returns {name, dataset_version, docs, mcp}.

Get a key: https://africacompliancedata.com/#pricing · Docs: https://africacompliancedata.com/docs · MCP server: https://api.africacompliancedata.com/mcp

license.name: Proprietary: use under the Terms of Service

servers.description: Website host (the API host redirects here)

get.summary: Free public iCalendar feed of national holidays (no key)
get.description: National holidays for all supported years, one all-day event per holiday. Estimated (moon-sighted) dates are TENTATIVE and keep their UID, so subscribed calendars move them when the official date is announced. Served on the website host only.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, either case, e.g. ke

404.description: Unknown country, or no verified holiday list for this country yet

get.summary: Your key: plan, status, rate limit and today's usage
get.description: Daily allowances count distinct countries read per UTC day. Does not count as a read.

status.description: A paused key gets 403 Access paused instead

get.summary: List your webhooks (with the last delivery result). Compliance plan
get.description: Events go to keys on the Compliance plan: each use of the key confirms its plan. A key not used for 14 days (13 at the earliest), moved to another plan, cancelled or paused receives no events until it is used again on Compliance.

post.summary: Create a webhook (returns its secret once). Compliance plan
post.description: At most 3 webhooks per key (409 beyond). The body must be at most 4,000 bytes (413 beyond). The URL must be a public https address on the standard port, without credentials.

countries.description: ISO codes; empty or omitted = all

features.description: Empty or omitted = all. 'vat' includes the VAT rate history, 'wht' the tax treaties.

note.description: Reminder to store the secret now

409.description: 3 webhooks already exist for this key; delete one first

delete.summary: Delete a webhook (and its queued events). Compliance plan

post.summary: Send a test event now. Compliance plan
post.description: Delivers a 'test' event immediately (one attempt; at most 5 tests per minute per key, then 429) and returns the HTTP status your URL answered, or the network error.

status.description: HTTP status of your endpoint, or 'error: ...'

get.summary: Announced and moon-sighted holidays across countries, estimated or confirmed
get.description: Holidays whose date depends on an announcement (Eid, Mawlid and other moon-sighted holidays, ad-hoc days off) from 7 days ago to `days` ahead, with status estimated (not announced yet; also weekend substitutes of estimated dates) or confirmed (with the official source). Countries without a verified holiday list are skipped. Shares the per-key limit of 5 requests per minute with full country profiles (429).

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO codes; omit for all countries (an empty value returns 400)

source_note.description: When the official notice is not online, or the date is known from a press report of it

announcements.description: Per country in the list: who announces the dates

get.summary: List the 54 countries with currency and coverage per feature
get.description: On Free and Starter, coverage lists only the holiday features.

get.summary: Full compliance profile of one country
get.description: Shares the per-key limit of 5 requests per minute with the holiday watch. Tax sections need the Pro or Compliance plan (on Free and Starter they are listed in not_in_plan). VAT history, treaties and finance-law digests have their own endpoints.
National holidays with status: rule, confirmed, estimated (moon-sighted, replaced by the official date once announced), observed (weekend substitute) or bridge.

parameters.name: include_religious_scopes
parameters.description: Also return holidays limited to one group (a faith, women, the public sector).

announcements.description: Who announces moon-sighted and ad-hoc holidays, and where

get.description: Subscribable calendar (RFC 5545): one all-day event per holiday. Estimated dates are TENTATIVE and keep the same UID, so subscribed calendars move them when the official date is announced. A free public feed of national holidays is also available without a key at https://africacompliancedata.com/calendar/{country}.ics (country code in either case).

404.description: Unknown country, or no verified holiday list for this country yet

get.summary: Is a date a working day?
Working days between two dates (both included)
The date N working days later (or earlier)
VAT rates, registration threshold and legal basis (and the standard rate on a date). Pro and Compliance
get.description: With `date`, also `standard_rate_on_date`: the standard rate in force that day, from the dated history. The history starts at its `covered_from` date (usually 2015-01-01); for an earlier date, or a country without a dated history, `standard_rate_on_date` is null and `warning` explains why. A period that began before the documented history carries `from_note`. Dates more than a year ahead return 400.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional: also return standard_rate_on_date, the rate in force on that date

standard_rate_on_date.description: Only with ?date; null before covered_from or without a dated history

get.summary: Standard VAT rate history (dated periods with the law that set each rate). Pro and Compliance
get.description: Coverage starts at the history's covered_from date (usually 2015-01-01) or at the earliest period backed by an official source; a period that began earlier carries from_note. Countries without a dated history return an empty list and a warning.

covered_from.description: First date the dated history covers

last_verified.description: When the history was last checked

get.summary: Withholding tax rates (resident and non-resident), with treaty rates for a recipient's country. Pro and Compliance

parameters.name: recipient_country
parameters.description: Optional: recipient's country of residence (ISO 3166-1 code other than the paying country; otherwise 400); adds the tax-treaty maximum rates as 'treaty'

treaty.description: Only with ?recipient_country. Without a treaty: partner and note only.

get.summary: Tax treaty maximum withholding rates of the paying country, per partner. Pro and Compliance
get.description: Which countries have treaty data: coverage.treaties in /v1/countries. Without data, or without a treaty with the partner asked, the list is empty and warning explains it. Treaty lists are partial: warning says so, and a missing partner does not mean there is no treaty.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Optional partner: ISO 3166-1 code other than the paying country (otherwise 400)

articles.description: Treaty articles for each rate, e.g. "Dividends: Art 10; Interest: Art 11; Royalties: Art 12"

last_verified.description: When this country's treaty list was last checked

get.summary: Latest finance law: business-relevant changes. Compliance plan only
get.description: Which countries have a digest: coverage.finance_law in /v1/countries. For the others finance_law is null and warning says so. Returns 403 on Free, Starter and Pro.

get.summary: Check a tax ID against the official format. Pro and Compliance
get.description: Checks the format (and the check digit where its algorithm is published). Does not confirm registration. The value is not stored or logged; to keep it out of URLs, use the MCP tool validate_tax_id_format, which sends it in the request body.

identifier.description: Absent when the country publishes no format

input_length.description: Only when no format is published

notes.description: Only when no format is published: what the authority says about the identifier

valid_format.description: null when no official format is published

get.summary: Tax filing and payment deadlines due in a month. Pro and Compliance
get.description: Due dates are adjusted for weekends and public holidays where the country's rule (weekend_adjust) or the deadline's own rule is known; otherwise the statutory date is returned with adjusted: false. statutory_date shows the date before adjustment. Rules without a fixed calendar date are listed in other_rules.

post.summary: Sent to your URL when data changes (type dataset.changed; type test from the test endpoint)
post.description: Change events are queued and delivered by a job that runs every 15 minutes; the test endpoint delivers at once. Verify the ACD-Signature header: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of t + '.' + raw body, keyed with your webhook secret>; reject events older than 5 minutes. Answer with a 2xx within 10 seconds. A 2xx, a 3xx (redirects are not followed) or a 4xx other than 429 ends the delivery (4xx answers are not retried); timeouts, network errors, 429 and 5xx are retried on the following runs, about every 15 minutes, up to 3 attempts in all, with the same event id (ACD-Event-Id), so receivers can de-duplicate. Up to 50 queued events are kept per key until delivered. VAT-history changes arrive under feature 'vat', tax-treaty changes under 'wht'.

parameters.name: ACD-Event-Id
parameters.description: Same as 'id' in the body; unchanged on retries

4XX.description: Rejected by the receiver: not retried (except 429)

Bearer.description: The same API key as a bearer token.

Country.name: country
Country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. KE, NG, ZA.

TreatyRate.description: Maximum source-country rate; null: no treaty limit recorded, the domestic rate applies; where a rate was not captured, the entry's notes say so

rate.description: A number, 'a/b' (see conditions) or 'none' (only the recipient's country may tax)

from_note.description: When the period started before the documented history, e.g. 'in force on 2015-01-01 (earlier start not covered)'

url.description: null when the official text is not available online; 'note' then explains it

source_type.description: e.g. statute, gazette, revenue_authority; 'secondary' when no official text has been confirmed

warning.description: When coverage is partial or gap, the year's holiday list is incomplete, or no value can be given

scope.description: national, or the group a holiday is limited to

observed_for.description: For a substitute day: the date of the holiday it replaces

moved_from.description: Original date of a holiday officially moved

bridge_for.description: For a bridge day: the holiday it bridges to

estimated.description: true on a weekend substitute of an estimated (moon-sighted) date: it moves with the announced date

source_url.description: Official announcement (confirmed dates); null when the official text is not online (source_note says where it was published)

source_note.description: Where the announcement was made when it is not published online, or that the date is known from a press report of the official announcement

coverage.description: Per feature: holidays, holiday_announcements, vat, wht, tin_format, filing_deadlines, vat_history, treaties, finance_law (Free and Starter: holiday features only)

id.description: Stable event id (evt_...; evt_test_... for tests), also in header ACD-Event-Id

holidays_confirmed.description: For holidays changes: dates newly confirmed by an official announcement

source_note.description: When the official notice is not online, or the date is known from a press report (can accompany source_url)

docs.description: Link to the webhook documentation (not on test events)

Paused.description: Key paused for review after unusual bulk access ('Access paused')

PlanRequired.description: Tax data needs the Pro or Compliance plan (or the key is paused for review)

CompliancePlanRequired.description: Needs the Compliance plan: finance-law digests and webhooks (or the key is paused for review)

NotFound.description: Unknown country, path or webhook id

Unavailable.description: Key check temporarily unavailable, or webhook storage unavailable (webhook endpoints); retry after Retry-After seconds

TestLimited.description: At most 5 test deliveries per minute per key, or the plan rate limit, or key checks busy (many new keys from your network); see Retry-After

RateLimited.description: Rate limit for the plan exceeded, or key checks busy (many new keys from your network); see Retry-After

BulkLimited.description: Plan rate limit exceeded, or the shared limit of 5 requests per minute for full country profiles and the holiday watch, or key checks busy (many new keys from your network); see Retry-After
